Let $u={log}_{3}⁡x=\frac{ln⁡x}{ln⁡3}$ and $v={x}^{2}.$ Then

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{xln⁡3}\,\text{and}\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=2x.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quotient rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}-u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}}{{v}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{({x}^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{xln⁡3}-\frac{ln⁡x}{ln⁡3}\cdot 2x)}{({x}^{2})^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{x}{ln⁡3}-\frac{2xln⁡x}{ln⁡3})}{{x}^{4}} \\  & =\frac{x-2xln⁡x}{{x}^{4}ln⁡3} \\  & =\frac{x(1-2ln⁡x)}{{x}^{4}ln⁡3} \\  & =\frac{1-2ln⁡x}{{x}^{3}ln⁡3} \\  & =(\,1-2ln⁡x\,)\cdot \frac{1}{{x}^{3}ln⁡3}.\end{aligned}
$$
